RWA.note: The National Bank of Rwanda announces a trial, but its role over licensing or oversight of eKash is not stated.
Nothing on consumer protection rules or complaints.

facts.fact: RadioTV10 reports that the National Bank of Rwanda and the National Bank of Cambodia launched on 15 November 2026 a proof-of-concept trial linking Cambodia's Bakong network to Rwanda's eKash, for one-way transfers from Cambodia to bank accounts and wallets in Rwanda.

systems.owner: National Bank of Rwanda and National Bank of Cambodia

RWA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
No survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: RadioTV10 says that in Rwanda eKash, operated by RSwitch, connects participating banks and mobile money providers, letting customers transfer funds between different financial platforms.

RadioTV10, citing the National Bank of Rwanda's October 2026 financial stability report, says eKash reached 14.6 million transactions a month worth Rwf1.2 trillion after its nationwide rollout in July 2026.

RWA.note: Nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
